Develop a character

Use the current catalog choices and the advancement rules below.

1. Assign six attributes from −2 to +2, totaling +3. These stay fixed; magic items may modify them but do not retroactively change creation benefits. 2. Choose ancestry and two of its five traits. Choose culture independently. 3. At level 0 choose one culture pair and one background pair. Each grants a discipline at rank 1 and its paired ability, including its requirements. 4. Receive 10 + Knowledge + Reason + Guile DP, including negative adjustments. Buy eligible Novice cards; no discipline purchases. Spend or lose this pool. 5. At level 1 choose a class, meeting minimum 0 in both required attributes; Odd has no minimums. Choose two distinct listed rank-1 disciplines and a class-exclusive level-1 signature. 6. Receive a fresh 10 + Knowledge + Reason + Guile DP. Duplicate grants give 1 DP each for that stage, not a replacement choice or automatic higher rank. Buy ranks at class prices and eligible abilities. Spend or lose the pool. 7. Resolve explicit equipment and recipe grants. One compatible weapon can serve several attacks; do not grant or count it twice. Describe its appearance now. 8. HP = 12 + ancestry contribution + class contribution + Fortitude + explicit chosen benefits. Capacity = 10 + 3 × Brawn. Every Bulk above capacity reduces Speed by 1. Speed = ancestry base + Agility − that penalty, minimum 0.

Record Stability 0 unless an explicit chosen trait, ability or item grants more. Use the highest applicable value, maximum 3; do not derive it from attributes.

Grit begins at 2 at level 1, plus one at levels 3 and 7. Grit expenditure persists; a purchased once-only card may grant another point. There is no class-based automatic attribute or HP growth. Small HP purchases are explicitly limited per level.

DA awards milestone levels. Level 2 onward grants 8 + new level DP; bank it, spend only in a DA-approved safe place. Tier 1/3/7 cards normally cost 2/4/8 DP. The six @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.0bf4c8ad89113132.JournalEntryPage.c0c043f22d65aa20]{1-DP shared abilities} are Novice exceptions: no discipline requirements, purchase once each, available at level 0 and later. Ranks must be purchased sequentially; no additional rank level gates. Cards have no prerequisite card chains. Receive one chosen class signature at 3 and 7; only class and level qualify it. No multiclassing or access to another class’s signatures.

Coins are one currency. The agreed target is 50–70 starting coins after card grants. The @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.0558be1f6014ee71.JournalEntryPage.880380bcd80cfec6]{starting allocation} is 40 + ancestry + culture + background + class. After resolving grants, use the @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.a8b099af3500d9f6.JournalEntryPage.cfa94361944ba875]{market}, record purchases, remaining coins, carried Bulk and occupied hands. The plain worn outfit is a universal starting baseline; packs and potions are purchased, not free. Gear sells for half price or trades at full value with a willing trader.

Language reference

The @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.b65e9644d24629f2.JournalEntryPage.0237eee3512bbfa9]{language defaults} supply Common plus one ordinary home language, followed by explicit extra grants. Apply explicit ancestry grants separately; culture choices do not restrict language.
